description: This file contains a static class `MinimalAllureResultsWriter` for generating minimal Allure test result JSON files during NUnit test execution. It creates a simplified Allure result JSON for environments lacking full adapter support or for tests that skip browser interactions.

classes.name: MinimalAllureResultsWriter
classes.description: A static utility class for writing minimal Allure JSON result files during NUnit test runs.

methods.name: WriteResultForCurrentTest
methods.description: Creates and writes a JSON file with test metadata and status for the current NUnit test execution.
